coverage_summary: Compared canonical Atlas (updated 2026-09-23), latest published Global Macro through 2026-10-23, existing October UK energy candidates and September Pix baseline. Cross-region discovery covered public payment interoperability (ECB/BCB Pix–TIPS assessment), African open-access broadband financing (World Bank/AfDB Nigeria BRIDGE), UK energy permits, European digital euro pilot, BIS cross-border payment research, FAO food logistics, WHO/WOAH health and security and IEA grids. Two medium-materiality structural watch hypotheses staged: feasibility is not an operating corridor; approved financing/investor selection plans are not equity close or installed fibre. No canonical Atlas change.
